title: Kuber ka ghamand aur Ganesh ji ki bhookh
hooks: Teeno lok ka sabse ameer devta... ek bachche ko khaana khila nahi paaya.
Ek mutthi chaawal ne Kuber ka ghamand tod diya.
Ganesh ji ki bhookh kisi se nahi mitti thi... ek ko chhod kar.
hook_why: Paradox in line 1 (richest god fails to feed a child), the pattern of the 12-13M winners: a twist the viewer hasn't heard.
metaphor: Endless gold cannot fill a child's stomach; one handful given with love can.

caption:
Teeno lok ka sabse ameer devta ek bachche ka pet nahi bhar paaya 🙏 Ek mutthi chaawal ne sab badal diya. (Lok katha) Aap ne kabhi dikhaave ke liye kuch kiya hai?

Music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

claims.basis: popular Indian lok-katha (folk tale) about Kuber's pride; not from a single Purana chapter, so the video says 'lok katha'.

ig.caption:
Kuber ke paas itna sona tha, fir bhi wo ek bachche ko khana na khila saka. Kyun?
Ek mutthi chaawal prem se khilane par Ganesh ji ka pet bhar gaya.
Kabhi dikhaave ke liye kuch kiya? Haan/Na
Us dost ko bhejo jo hamesha mehengi cheezein dikhaata rehta hai

yt.description:
Kuber ke ghamand ko todne ke liye Ganesh ji ne khaaya saara khana.
Mahadev ne ek mutthi chaawal prem se khilaya, aur bhagwan tript hue.
Bhagwan ko sona nahi, bhaav chahiye.

figures.name: Kuber
figures.look: Plump middle‑aged deity, golden crown atop short black hair, broad smiling face, deep brown eyes, heavy gold necklaces, armlets, anklets, crimson silk dhoti with gold embroidery, bare chest adorned with jeweled chains, holds a golden money pot in left hand, right hand raised in gesture.

figures.name: Lord Shiva
figures.look: Tall serene deity, ash‑grey blue skin, long matted dreadlocks tied with a crescent moon, third eye on forehead, serpent coiled around neck, tiger‑skin loincloth, bare chest smeared with ash, trident resting beside, damru hanging from wrist, seated cross‑legged on icy peak.

figures.name: Bal Ganesh
figures.look: Young child deity, elephant head with one broken tusk, large expressive eyes, small trunk curled, pot‑belly, four arms (two holding modak, two blessing), bright red silk dhoti with gold trim, gold crown with tiny jewels, seated on golden throne, gentle smile.

places.name: KuberPalaceHall
places.look: Vast rectangular hall, walls of polished gold panels, high arched ceiling with intricate filigree, floor of mirrored marble reflecting golden light, rows of empty golden plates on long tables, towering pillars carved with lotus motifs, soft warm glow from hidden lamps.

places.name: KuberTreasureHall
places.look: Endless vaulted chamber, mountains of gold coins spilling over jeweled chests, walls lined with shelves of rubies, emeralds, pearls, servants in crimson livery carrying golden trays, ceiling fresco of celestial dancers, radiant amber light.

places.name: MountKailash
places.look: Snow‑capped sacred peak, sheer white cliffs dusted with glittering frost, a flat plateau of pale stone where a simple stone seat rests, thin mist swirling, distant sound of conch, pale sunrise painting horizon pink.

places.name: GrandDiningHall
places.look: Opulent dining hall, long teak table covered with embroidered cloth, massive golden thali centered, ornate silver cutlery, walls hung with tapestries of deities, chandeliers of crystal casting soft gold, attendants in white turbans standing reverently.

places.name: PalaceKitchen
places.look: Huge kitchen, towering copper cauldrons cold and empty, stone shelves bare, massive grinding stones idle, fire pits dark, cooks in simple dhotis with worried expressions, steam absent, faint scent of sandalwood.

places.name: SnowyPathKailash
places.look: Steep winding path up icy slope, packed snow crunching underfoot, pine trees laden with frost, prayer flags fluttering blue, distant silhouette of temple spire, pale moonlight casting silver highlights.

places.name: SimpleLeafPlateSetting
places.look: Modest outdoor space, single banana leaf plate on low wooden stool, few grains of rice glistening, small clay diya flickering, surrounding grass soft, gentle golden aura enveloping scene.

places.name: TempleBackground
places.look: Ancient stone temple sanctum, carved pillars with lotus capitals, sanctum doorway framed by torana, single oil lamp glowing, floor of polished black stone, faint incense smoke rising, warm amber hue.

places.name: GoldenBackground
places.look: Soft gradient backdrop of radiant gold, subtle texture of woven silk, faint mandala pattern embossed, gentle light rays emanating outward, no architecture, pure luminous field.
